target: Official report states no fires were reported nationally on the report date; not a sensor-confirmed physical no-fire label.

method.candidate_reports: Every cached/downloaded SNMF PDF in the available manifests, including reports with parsed event rows so contradictory evidence can be detected.
method.confirmation_rule: Manifest PDF hash matches; extractable PDF text contains the exact normalized phrase "NO SE REPORTARON INCENDIOS EN EL TERRITORIO NACIONAL"; and an internal PDF date matches the archive date.
method.route_day_mapping: Each explicitly national no-fire report covers all eight route sectors for the report date as a negative official-report proxy, at either spatial radius.

limitations: The phrase certifies what the official report says, not that no unreported or undetected physical fire existed.
A national no-fire report is useful for training/evaluating the target of nearby officially reported fire only.
A report date has daily, not hourly, temporal resolution and cannot verify 24-hour forecast lead from ignition.
This audit does not evaluate any model, precision, recall, calibration, or event-level independence.
